data.description:
## Story

As the epic owner, the epic description has SC10 added (end-to-end PR validation) and SCs 1, 5, 6, 8, 9 are reconciled to match the actual implementation so that the completion verifier passes on factually-correct criteria and the user's requirement for live PR observation is durably captured.

## Done Definitions

- [ ] SC10 added to epic b575-ac1c-f720-4839 description with text: "End-to-end validation: a real PR on this project triggers the cycle-end arbiter and we observe BLOCK/DEFER/DROP rulings processed correctly through the revised workflow. Evidence required for closure: (a) PR URL with arbiter PR comment posted; (b) at least one DEFER ruling produced an orphan ticket (ticket ID recorded); (c) at least one DROP ruling produced a defense record (record ID recorded); (d) BLOCK ruling demonstrated (synthetic scenario); (e) all artifacts visible in epic description as evidence subsection."
- [ ] SC1 updated: enum vocabulary for cross_reviewer_agreement (4-value) and cross_cycle_pattern (7-value) defined inside Story 12's done definitions; SC1 text amended to reference the enum vocabulary as 'per Story 12 DDs' rather than inline restating values.
- [ ] SC5 updated: tag is `orphan:deferred_review` + `origin:arbiter` (matches the actual implementation in S5 / Story 11), not `defer` + `origin:arbiter`. Change rationale: brainstorm decision #9 said 'defer' tag, but during implementation the more-descriptive `orphan:deferred_review` was chosen for grep-ability. Both tags required for validate-issues.sh exemption.
- [ ] SC6 updated: 8-category impact_class floor enforcement is now scoped to Story 12 (which extends the BLOCK-gate AND-logic). Text amended to clarify scope and reference Story 12.
- [ ] SC8 updated: orphan-task-convention.md is at `docs/orphan-task-convention.md` (project-local), not `plugins/dso/docs/`. Rationale: project consumer-facing docs go to the project's docs/ tree per dev-team artifact convention (CLAUDE.md Architectural Invariant 3).
- [ ] SC9 updated: fixture corpus assertions for cross_cycle_pattern + cross_reviewer_agreement enum vocabularies are added by Story 12 (which updates the fixtures). SC9 text amended to mark vocabulary assertions as 'per Story 12 DDs'.
- [ ] Implementation Status table added to epic description (Markdown table mapping each SC# to DONE / IMPL_VERIFIED / PENDING / DEFERRED-TO-FOLLOW-ON with story reference). Verifiable at-a-glance status.

## Considerations

- [Doc-only] No code changes. Single edit to epic ticket description.
- [Ordering] Should happen early so completion-verifier on epic operates against accurate criteria. Can run in parallel with code stories.
- [Atomic edit] Use `dso ticket update` or equivalent atomic mechanism. Don't do partial-state edits.
- [Escalation policy] Escalate when blocked.
data.title: As the epic owner, the epic description has SC10 (end-to-end PR validation) and SCs 1, 5, 6, 8, 9 reconciled to match the actual implementation
